time_horizon: <int> Latest time unit in the discrete planning horizon by which all jobs must finish.
total_processing_time: <int> Sum of processing times across all jobs.
p_max: <int> Longest processing time among all jobs.

jobs.processing_time: <int> Number of time units required to complete the job on a machine.
jobs.weight: <int> Importance weight of the job, used to penalize late completion.
jobs.due_date: <int> Time by which the job should ideally be completed to avoid a tardiness penalty.

parameters.n: <int> Number of jobs to be scheduled.
parameters.m: <int> Number of identical parallel machines available.
